events.what_en: Listing of third tranche placement shares

recent_en: SYMLIFE completed the third and final tranche of its private placement in October 2026, issuing 20,600,700 new shares at RM0.1460 each, listed on 23 October. Over the same period, XOX BHD and XOX (Hong Kong) Limited filed changes in substantial shareholder interests. The company also had material litigation announcements and released quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Completed the third and final tranche of its private placement, issuing 20,600,700 new shares at RM0.1460 each, listed on 23 October 2026.
XOX BHD and XOX (Hong Kong) Limited filed changes in substantial shareholder interests.
The company made material litigation announcements.
risks_en: The private placement issued new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
The company has material litigation matters.
